_: The town shows the realm's state in its streets (town_life.gd _moods; docs/TUNING.md). The state is the bridge's (each city's atWar, famine, celebrating in /world, and the muster scene for a levy, read through works.gd states); this only says how it looks. on: the switch (--moods=off: the town dressed as before). A state's row: stalls_open (the share of market stalls still kept: the rest stand shut, no keeper, no buyers), rack (swords on the armoury rack when it starts), hammer (how fast the smiths swing, times their own pace), muster (men gathered in the square: men, rows, how far from the well toward the seen side in world units, and the share of them soldiers), leave (a levy: every [fewest, most] seconds a file of men (file, spacing apart in world units) shoulder their bundles and march out along the road in column, until most have gone, so the town sees a column on its road; kin: who stays at the square to see them off), grief (a death mourned at the town: stalls_open, out (the share of its people still about), candles and flowers set round the centrepiece, black cloth over the doors of the houses nearest the square, the bell tolling every toll seconds, and a funeral round the square: bearers with the bier, mourners behind, a priest before, at pace, ring as a share of the square's radius, spacing apart), dole (a famine: a line at the dole table where the hungry are given bread, men in it, at which of the town's places), feast (bonfire: its flames, the fire's own flame shader (fire.gd): how many, how big, how fast they rise, and its light's strength and reach; tables: long tables set in the square, seats a side; bunting: lines of pennants from a pole by the well out to poles round the square, height in metres, flags a line, sag in metres; colours: the house's, then these). A court ruling standing at the town (the bridge's rulings.js) is a state too, and the herald cries it in the square with listeners cheering or dismayed (works.json counts.listeners, weights): relief (Manor Lords' market approval: buyers [fewest, most] at each stall, goods heaped as in good times), justice (Stronghold's gallows and CK3's dread: an empty gallows at the square's seen edge, guards and a silent crowd, from_well out), grant (CK3's granted holding: the house's banners round the square, ring out, and a building site for it, site a Freeciv building name read as its kit, progress risen), build (Manor Lords' works: the ordered work's site with its builders).
_centre: Round the square's centrepiece (a fountain at a seat; towns.gd root meta centrepiece, its real footprint): how far past its basin's rim things stand (game units). mourners: the grief's kneelers (and anyone set down near the heart: the levy's kin, dogs, children); stall: a good year's extra stall by the well (its canopy); candles: their candles set down; bunting: the feast's tall pole; fire: the feast's bonfire (past its own heat too), moved off the heart to the seen side, its dancers and tables round it.
